purpose: Phase-5B.1 SIGNALING PREDICTION registry. Records every predictive claim explicitly, with its basis and any cross-context transfer made EXPLICIT (never silent). ARCHITECTURE + EVIDENCE ONLY. A prediction is acceptable only when labelled; it is never presented as experimental. No human->mouse or mouse->rat pathway is transferred silently; where a transfer would be needed and cannot be justified, the entry is NOT_REPORTED.

definitions.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PREDICTION: Strong, convergent support (e.g. same drug + closely related cell context) but not measured in THIS context.
definitions.LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION: Reported for the drug/drug-class in the literature but not in the frozen package and not verified in repo.
definitions.MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION: Inferred from mechanism/canonical biology without a direct drug-in-context report.

pred_h1_exposure_ros.claim: Celastrol exposure elevates ROS in HaCaT (entry to oxidative-stress axis)

pred_h1_ros_mapk_nrf2_are.claim: ROS->MAPK->Nrf2->ARE cascade operates in HaCaT under celastrol exposure
pred_h1_ros_mapk_nrf2_are.cross_context_transfer: canonical relationship applied TO human HaCaT context (explicit, not silent)
pred_h1_ros_mapk_nrf2_are.note: Relationship established generally; its OPERATION in this context is the predicted part. STOP before transcription.

pred_h1_are_ho1.claim: ARE regulatory state raises HO-1 signaling output in HaCaT
pred_h1_are_ho1.note: Output STATE only; no protein expression.

pred_h2_nfkb_suppression.claim: Celastrol suppresses NF-κB signaling in HaCaT
pred_h2_nfkb_suppression.note: Well described for celastrol generally; not in frozen package for HaCaT.

pred_h2_nfkb_inflammatory.claim: Reduced NF-κB reduces inflammatory signaling output
pred_h2_nfkb_inflammatory.cross_context_transfer: canonical relationship applied TO human HaCaT context (explicit)

pred_m1_pi3k_suppression.claim: Celastrol suppresses PI3K in B16BL6 melanoma
pred_m1_pi3k_suppression.note: Mouse melanoma; not in frozen package.

pred_m1_akt_mtor_survival.cross_context_transfer: canonical relationship applied TO mouse melanoma context (explicit)

human_to_mouse.note: The human HaCaT oxidative-stress / NF-κB axes are NOT transferred to mouse melanoma. The mouse profile (5B-M1) is built independently on canonical PI3K/AKT/mTOR biology applied to the mouse context.

mouse_to_rat.note: No rat cellular signaling profile exists; nothing is transferred to rat.

human_to_rat.note: No rat cellular signaling profile exists; nothing is transferred to rat.

cross_context_transfer_ledger.rule: Only canonical GENERAL relationships are 'applied to' a context (recorded explicitly above). CONTEXT-SPECIFIC pathways (a whole profile) are never copied across species or cell models.

rat_any.note: No valid predictive basis for rat cellular signaling without a cellular model; deliberately left empty.

target_mediated_start.note: Because the Phase-5A molecular target is NOT REPORTED, no target-mediated (as opposed to exposure-driven) prediction is made.
